title: Ser vs. Estar
explanation: Both mean 'to be', but 'ser' is for permanent traits/identity (Soy alto) and 'estar' is for temporary states/location (Estoy cansado).

examples.text: El libro está en la mesa.

title: Gender of Nouns: el / la
explanation: Spanish nouns are masculine (el) or feminine (la). Most nouns ending in -o are masculine, most ending in -a are feminine, though there are exceptions.

title: Present Tense Regular Verbs
explanation: Regular verbs fall into three groups by ending: -ar, -er, -ir. Drop the ending and add the matching set for each subject.

title: Question Words
explanation: Spanish question words all carry a written accent mark: qué, quién, dónde, cuándo, cómo, por qué.
